title: Language membership indicator
statement: Given a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, an index $j\in\{0,1,2,3\}$, and a binary word $V$, define the Boolean value to be $1$ exactly when $V$ belongs to the $j$th language in the four-language family associated with $N$, and $0$ otherwise.
